question.question: Does adding an asymmetric low-rank real-atom triangle multiplicative pair update at layers 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 improve matched 100K development MAE on the accepted BondLocal+PairNorm GPTrans-T parent?
question.deficiency: In GPTrans-T, pair states update only via 1D outer-product projection from node attention without direct 2D path composition across real atoms. Whether asymmetric outgoing and incoming triangle multiplicative updates over real atoms 1..N_max at alternating layers improve over the retained BondLocal+PairNorm GPTrans-T parent under strict same-job initialization parity is unmeasured.
alternatives: Node-to-pair outer-product updates already capture three-atom path geometry
Real-atom triangle contractions add pair capacity without improving generalization
Effect is below the 3 meV material gate
question.positive_decision: Nominate only for candidate-minus-reference selected EMA MAE <= -3.0 meV and paired 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 under strict acceptance; no automatic scale-up.
question.negative_decision: Close this real-atom triangle pair intervention without hyperparameter grids or automatic retries.
